subject: Trading
title: Engulfing Patterns
description: A fast breakdown of Engulfing Patterns for builders.

hook.text: A small red candle followed by a large green candle that completely swallows it—that's a bullish engulfing.

buildup.text: The second candle's body fully contains the first. Buyers overwhelmed sellers with a decisive statement.

discovery.text: Bearish engulfing is the mirror: a small green candle swallowed by a large red one. Sellers took control.

twist.text: Engulfing patterns are strongest at key support or resistance levels, not in the middle of a range.

climax.text: The pattern shows a power shift—one side completely overwhelmed the other in a single session.

punchline.text: When one candle eats another, momentum shifted.

quiz.question: What does a bullish engulfing pattern show?
options: Buyers overwhelmed sellers—the second candle fully contains the first
